note: The toolchains BrokenDev builds games with that do not ship inside a project archive, pinned like the emulators (emulators.json): the release zip by name, size and sha256, the folder it is unpacked into under BROKENDEV_HOME, and key files by size and sha256, so 'doctor' and every build can tell the pinned toolchain is there and unchanged. BrokenDev never downloads or unpacks a toolchain: the user approves each download, and the zip stays in its _downloads folder as the proof of what was unpacked. Validated by lib\Toolchains.ps1 (Test-BdToolchains) and tests\run-tests.ps1. Build steps name a toolchain's folder as {toolchain:<id>}; a project needing one lists 'toolchain:<id>' in requires.tools.

toolchains.title: GBDK-2020 (C and assembly for the Game Boy: lcc, SDCC, sdasgb, sdldgb, makebin)
toolchains.source: the GBDK-2020 4.5.0 release for 64-bit Windows (https://github.com/gbdk-2020/gbdk-2020/releases), downloaded with the user's approval on 2026-10-24 for VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code
toolchains.sha256Source: measured when it was downloaded (recorded beside the zip in gbdk-win64-4.5.0.zip.sha256)
toolchains.notes: GBDK's start-up (crt0) zeroes the C variables' own area (_DATA) but, since 4.x, not the rest of work RAM (its ChangeLog: so emulators can flag reads before writes); VRUN: Vaults of Obsolete Code clears the rest itself (src/start_up.s) and BrokenDev's gb.ram-uninit check proves nothing is read unwritten. Its console library (printf, font_init) switches the LCD on while it loads its font, which makes lag frames at start-up: the game draws its own text.

toolchains.title: cc65 (6502 C compiler and the ca65 assembler / ld65 linker, for the NES)
toolchains.source: the cc65 project's official Windows snapshot (https://sourceforge.net/projects/cc65/files/cc65-snapshot-win32.zip, linked from https://cc65.github.io/getting-started.html; the GitHub releases V2.17-V2.19 ship sources only, no Windows binaries), downloaded with the user's approval on 2026-10-26 for the ca65 debug-port library (BrokenDev D7); 'ca65 --version' says 'ca65 V2.19 - Git 5725066' (built 2026-10-24)
toolchains.sha256Source: measured when it was downloaded (recorded beside the zip in cc65-snapshot-win32.zip.sha256); the snapshot link always serves the newest build, so this pin is what proves which one was unpacked
toolchains.notes: The snapshot has no version file; the pinned ca65.exe / ld65.exe hashes are the version. Used by BrokenDev\debugport\ca65\build-proof.ps1 (the debug-port include assembled and linked into a small NROM test ROM).

toolchains.title: SDCC (the Small Device C Compiler: sdcc, sdasz80, sdldz80, sdar, for the Master System and Game Gear)
toolchains.source: the SDCC 4.6.0 release for 64-bit Windows, the official installer from https://sourceforge.net/projects/sdcc/files/sdcc-win64/4.6.0/sdcc-4.6.0-x64-setup.exe (the newest release on 2026-11-02), downloaded with the user's approval (2026-10-30) for the Sega VRUN ports (S0); the NSIS installer is unpacked with 7-Zip (never run), its $PLUGINSDIR left out; 'sdcc --version' says '4.6.0 #16555 (MINGW64)'
toolchains.sha256Source: measured when it was downloaded (recorded beside it in sdcc-4.6.0-x64-setup.exe.sha256); SourceForge publishes no sha256 for it
toolchains.notes: Used with devkitSMS by the Master System and Game Gear ports (vrun-ctw-sms, vrun-voc-gg). GBDK carries its own SDCC build for the Game Boy: this one is separate.

toolchains.title: devkitSMS (sverx: SMSlib, PSGlib, crt0_sms, makesms, assets2banks; C for the Master System and Game Gear with SDCC)
toolchains.source: sverx/devkitSMS at commit 533ae572c897cf44f1da865013ebf690134301a3 (2026-09-29, the head of its master branch on 2026-11-02), the archive https://github.com/sverx/devkitSMS/archive/533ae572c897cf44f1da865013ebf690134301a3.zip; its newest tagged release (v1.2, 2022) is four years older, and the project is used from its repository, so the commit is the pin; downloaded with the user's approval (2026-10-30) for the Sega VRUN ports (S0)
toolchains.sha256Source: measured when it was downloaded (recorded beside the zip)
toolchains.notes: Unpacked as the zip's top folder renamed to devkitSMS. Its shipped SMSlib*.lib / crt0_sms.rel were built by an older SDCC: their modules record '-mz80' where SDCC 4.6.0 records '-mz80 sdcccall(1)', and SDCC 4.6.0's linker refuses to mix them ('Conflicting sdcc options', exit 1). The ports' build.ps1 therefore rebuild SMSlib and crt0 from this commit's own sources (SMSlib/src/Makefile's rules) once, into the port's build folder.

toolchains.title: SGDK (Sega Genesis Development Kit: m68k gcc, make, libmd, rescomp; C for the Genesis / Mega Drive)
toolchains.source: the SGDK 2.11 release (April 2025, the newest release on 2026-11-02), https://github.com/Stephane-D/SGDK/releases/download/v2.11/sgdk211.7z, downloaded with the user's approval (2026-10-30) for Super VRUN on the Genesis (S0); unpacked with 7-Zip
toolchains.sha256Source: measured when it was downloaded (recorded beside it); its size is the one GitHub's release lists
toolchains.notes: Its makefile.gen runs Java for sizebnd.jar (the ROM's padding and checksum) and rescomp.jar (resources): the machine's JDK is used, not pinned here. On Windows its LTO link prints 'Error 127 (ignored)' (-flto=auto's make jobserver); the ROM is complete. The symbols are SGDK's out/symbol.txt (m68k nm -n), which BrokenNes's symbol reader takes.

toolchains.title: WLA-DX (multi-CPU assembler and linker: wla-z80, wla-68000, wla-65816, wla-spc700, wla-gb, wlalink)
toolchains.source: the WLA-DX v10.7 release for 64-bit Windows (2026-06-28, the newest release on 2026-11-02), https://github.com/vhelin/wla-dx/releases/download/v10.7/wla_dx_v10.7_Win64.zip, downloaded with the user's approval (2026-10-30) for assembly in the Sega VRUN ports (S0); the release's vc_redist installers were not downloaded (the zip carries vcruntime140.dll)
